interpretation: Every FCP white-state node class that is represented in the published significant-DEG table is downregulated in experimental summer-white flowers.
The overlap spans both structural pathway entry (CHS), glycosylation/output (U75C1/U78D2), and regulatory layers (MYB90, TTG1).
Additional anthocyanin-pathway context genes PAL, 4CL and DFR are also significantly lower in summer-white flowers.
F3H, ANS, FLS and bHLH are absent from the significant-DEG table; absence is not evidence of unchanged expression.
comparison_semantics: summer relative to spring; negative logFC = lower expression in summer-white flowers
hard_nonclaims: not an outcome-blind confirmation because the published paper already reports pathway repression
temperature and photoperiod changed together in the paired RNA-seq comparison
does not rescue the failed cross-cohort BIO5 replication
does not establish identical orthology or causal nucleotide changes across FCP systems
